title: ＜ランナーの皆さまへ＞給水所のご案内（東京マラソン2026）
claims: The 2026 race day had 15 aid stations on the course.
The linked official aid-station PDF places the 15 stations at 5, 7, 10, 12, 15, 17, 20, 22, 25, 27, 30, 32, 35, 38 and 40 km.
All 15 stations provide drinking water; Pocari Sweat is provided at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40 km.
The official PDF lists sponge cake at 20, 25 and 30 km; pickled plum at 22, 27 and 38 km; cream bread at 22 km; chocolate at 27 and 38 km; and ningyo-yaki at 27 km.
Advance notice boards are placed 150-300 m before each aid station.
Runners are asked to take water from the rear tables to reduce congestion at the front.
Paper cups are collected separately, and rubbish must go into the bins at the aid station.
The organiser accepts no responsibility for water or food taken outside the official aid stations.
Food allergen information is displayed for the eight main specified ingredients.
A start-area drinks station is also provided.
